text:
Sam (People Ops): Hey folks  dropping a compact manager checklist focused on Week 0-1 office & setup essentials + a short 30/60/90 scaffold. Trying to keep it paste-ready for calendar invites. Please flag anything missing. Link to canonical folder: https://redwood.ok/onboard-mini :wave:

Sam (People Ops): Week0 (pre-start): confirm desk/hardware, request peripherals, submit IT provisioning form, assign buddy, send intro note to squad. Include an "access matrix" in IT ticket (vpn, repo, k8s, metrics).

Morgan (Eng Manager): Love the access matrix idea. Two asks: 1) add a short manager 1:1 script (10-15m) for Day1, 2) include a tiny "office essentials" checklist (where to find meeting rooms, printing, expense card).

Sam (People Ops): Added both. Manager 1:1 script bullets: role purpose, top 3 immediate priorities, preferred comms, clarification on 30/60/90 expectations, blockers to remove. Office essentials: building entry, badge pickup, parking, expense policy link.

Lee (IT): For hardware/access: managers open IT ticket with title "New Hire: [Name] - Provisioning" and include start date + access matrix. If ticket submitted before 10:00 PST on start day, we usually provision same-day. For secrets/KMS/HSM requests, include manager sign-off in the ticket body. Link: https://redwood.ok/it-provision.

Casey (DevEx): Dev onboarding notes: add quick links to repo readme, local dev bootstrap, and a labeled "starter-issues" board. We'll auto-label first-PRs from new accounts with "onboard-starter" so reviewers spot them. Suggest tiny PR rubric to paste into PR description.

Sam (People Ops): Tiny PR rubric (paste into PR body):
```
Summary: one sentence
Why: context for change
Local steps: how to run tests
Checklist: [ ] unit tests included [ ] lint passes [ ] 1 reviewer from squad
```

Morgan (Eng Manager): Also recommend a Day5 1.5h deploy-shadow slot for the new hire to observe release flow and post-deploy checks. Good to pair on a small non-critical fix that day.

Sam (People Ops): Noted  adding deploy-shadow to Day5. Buddy plan: peer buddy (not manager), 4 weeks pairing commitment, daily 15m stand week1 then twice weekly. Buddy hosts a "how we ship" 20m demo in week1.

Casey (DevEx): For 30/60/90 scaffold include measurable examples: 30d complete local dev + 1 small PR, 60d own a service or domain + reduce a flaky test, 90d lead a small feature or incident postmortem. Add an "evidence" field (links to PRs, deploys, runbook updates).

Sam (People Ops): Adding a one-slide "who to ask" card for the welcome packet: payroll, benefits, IT, security, oncall, facilities. Will include contact handles and expected SLA for responses.

Riley (new-hire): Thanks  quick Q: where do I request a standing desk mat and which expense category?

Lee (IT): Riley  submit a ticket via https://redwood.ok/facilities and tag "ergonomics". Expense code: OFF_EQ. Facilities will confirm pickup or shipping.

Riley (new-hire): Great thanks! Also excited about the deploy shadow  will RSVP to the calendar invite.

OnboardBot: Calendar invites created: Week1 onboarding block (Mon-Fri 10:00-12:00 local) and Day5 deploy-shadow 14:00-15:30 local. Manager, buddy, and new hire added to events.

Sam (People Ops): Final note: managers please confirm buddy and submit IT provisioning at offer acceptance or at least 48h before start. I'll publish the paste-ready card + fillable 30/60/90 template to the drive and update the folder link by EOD. Thanks! :sparkles:
